evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Keep code formatted and clean through conservative formatting and lint repairs.
intent.acceptance: Partial facet: existing non-generated Go files become the exact canonical gofmt output without other source edits. Count signed repairs and exact reversals; JavaScript formatting, other lint rules, behavior and full tests remain separate.

evidence.opportunity: Existing non-generated tracked Go files with exact canonical gofmt transformations.
filters: Immutable first-parent source changes, excluding vendor, testdata, node_modules and .git.
Generated files are excluded; syntactically unavailable formatting stays unknown, not clean.
Native source progress does not establish behavior preservation, full lint acceptance or sole workflow causation.
Workflow contributions require corroborated retained output-to-merge graph links.
Credit exact gofmt output only; reverse exact transformations withdraw credit.
evidence.collection: Replay shared immutable Go source features and one retained workflow linkage archive per batch.

model.architecture: Version-pinned native source oracle and corroborated GitHub outcome graph.
model.recommendation: Review partial native delivery independently from full acceptance and costs; no keep bar is inferred.

metrics.name: Repository exact go formatting repairs
metrics.formula: exact canonical formatting repairs minus exact reversals

metrics.name: Corroborated workflow-linked exact go formatting repairs
metrics.formula: the same signed native effects restricted to corroborated merge revisions

metrics.name: Observed repository native subtotal
metrics.formula: known signed native repository effects, retaining partial progress through unknown source assessments

metrics.name: Observed workflow-linked native subtotal
metrics.formula: known corroborated native effects, retaining partial progress through unknown source assessments
